newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Metro Bank to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Metro Bank to issue new shares.

text.p: Bangkok Metropolitan Bank Plc said on Friday it would issue 518.29 million new ordinary shares at 10 baht par.
The bank said the issuance of new ordinary shares was aimed at increasing its registered capital to 15 billion baht ($576.92 million) from the current 9.82 billion baht.
The bank said out of the total shares, 218.29 million will be offered to existing shareholders at a ratio of nine old shares for two new shares.
Booking and payment for the new shares will be held between June 2-6, it said.
It said that the increase in the registered capital will be used for the bank's operations, especially for its credit offering.
